styles.base: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged hanji paper texture. Bright, clear, high contrast, faces large and readable. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.sil: Korean minhwa ink-wash painting on hanji paper mixed with bold acrylic painting in the style of a sunset landscape: sky of layered flat gray and silver clouds with ribbons of gold, orange and red glowing between them, figures and trees as solid black silhouettes, blue-violet shadows. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.web: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style, matching the style of the reference image: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged cream hanji paper. Bright and clear, faces large and readable. No text, no letters anywhere.

characters.GUMAN: a weathered ferryman in his fifties, topknot under a worn headband, patched undyed hemp jacket and knee length trousers, bare feet or straw sandals, every garment gray or beige
characters.KIM: a thin old man of about seventy with a white beard, bare headed, plain white jeogori, poor and worn
characters.SUBOK: a man in his thirties, topknot, patched gray servant jacket and trousers, straw sandals, tired face, never silk
characters.ELDER: a village elder with a gray beard, black gat hat and a gray durumagi

scenes.S01: No people anywhere: the inside of a small riverside hut, many pairs of Korean straw sandals hanging in long rows from the wooden rafters. Every sandal is woven of straw in the same dull straw color. A river through the open doorway. Nobody, no hands, nothing written.
scenes.S02: GUMAN standing in a village courtyard holding up one pair of straw sandals above his head with both hands, his face firm, a heap of straw sandals on the ground beside him, village elders in black gat hats standing around him and staring. Daylight.
scenes.S05: Only one person in the picture: GUMAN standing at the stern of a flat wooden ferry boat poling it across a wide calm river, low green hills on the far bank, morning mist on the water. Nobody else in the boat.
scenes.S06: A river ferry landing crowded with ordinary village people waiting: women with bundles on their heads, a man with an A frame carrier, a farmer leading an ox, all standing at the water edge. A wooden boat approaching. Daylight, nothing written anywhere.
scenes.S07: Exactly two people and nobody else at a river landing: a poor man in a patched hemp jacket holding out one pair of woven straw sandals with both hands, and GUMAN receiving them with a small nod. A wooden boat behind them. Daylight.
scenes.S08: Only one person: GUMAN reaching up to hang one pair of Korean straw sandals on a rafter inside a small riverside hut. Many pairs of plain straw colored sandals hang in rows around him. Every sandal is woven of straw, all the same dull straw color. Warm lamplight. Nobody else.
scenes.S09: [SIL] Sunset over a wide river, a small flat ferry boat with one standing poleman as a black silhouette on the golden water, layered gray and silver clouds with ribbons of gold above.
scenes.S10: GUMAN standing at the stern inside a crowded ferry boat, both his bare feet planted on the wooden deck planks inside the hull, holding his pole, while the seated passengers around him talk with each other and nobody looks at him. His whole body is inside the boat, above the deck. Daylight on the river.
scenes.S11: Only one person in the picture: GUMAN sitting alone on the edge of his moored boat at dusk, looking across the water at a distant village, his pole laid beside him. Nobody else.
scenes.S12: Only one person in the picture: KIM, a thin old man of about seventy with a white beard, lying flat on his back on a floor mat under a thin quilt in a poor thatched house room, bare headed, one small lamp on the floor. Nobody else, plain walls, nothing written.
scenes.S13: Four village women standing around a well talking with sour faces, one of them gesturing toward a distant thatched roof. Ordinary hemp clothes in dull colors. Daylight village lane, nothing written.
scenes.S14: Only one person, seen full length: SUBOK standing alone at the dark edge of a wide river at night, his back half turned, looking across the black water. The night sky is completely covered with thick dark clouds and is empty. Reeds at the water edge.
scenes.S15: Exactly two people and nobody else at a river landing at night: GUMAN standing in a small boat holding his pole, and SUBOK stepping in with his head lowered. One lantern at the bow, black water, no moon.
scenes.S16: Only one person in the picture: a man in a worn servant jacket standing outside a low thatched house wall at night, looking at the dim lamplight in the window, one hand on the wall, his back half turned to leave. Nobody else, night.
scenes.S17: A close view filling the frame: GUMAN poling his boat at first light with SUBOK sitting in the bow, seen from the side, misty river water filling the rest of the frame. No empty sky, nothing written.
scenes.S19: A poor thatched house with a small plain funeral bier being carried out through the gate by four men in white hemp clothes, a few neighbors following. Daylight, nothing written anywhere.
scenes.S20: Five village people standing in a small yard in white hemp mourning clothes, shaking their heads with sour disapproving faces and looking toward an empty gate. Every mouth is closed, no tongue showing. Daylight, plain earth yard.
scenes.S21: Four village elders with gray beards sitting on a wooden veranda in gray durumagi and black gat hats, talking with serious faces, one of them gesturing. Daylight, tiled roof behind.
scenes.S22: No people anywhere: the empty earth yard of a small thatched house, a closed wooden door, a broken jar in the corner, bare winter branches above the low wall. Nobody, nothing written.
scenes.S23: Only one person: GUMAN sitting alone on the floor of his hut looking up at rows of Korean straw sandals hanging from the rafters. Every sandal is woven of straw in the same dull straw color. One oil lamp beside him, night. Nobody else.
scenes.S24: Only one person in the picture: GUMAN walking up a village lane carrying a wooden A frame on his back loaded high with many pairs of straw sandals tied together, his face set. Winter daylight, low walls along the lane. Nobody else.
scenes.S26: GUMAN standing in the middle of a village courtyard with a loaded A frame carrier beside him, four elders in gray durumagi and black gat hats standing around him with annoyed faces, villagers watching from behind. Daylight.
scenes.S27: A great heap of woven straw sandals spilled on the bare ground of a village courtyard, more than a hundred pairs. GUMAN stands beside the heap with an empty wooden A frame carrier. Village elders in black gat hats and a crowd stare down at the heap with open mouths. Winter daylight.
scenes.S28: A close view filling the frame: GUMAN holding up one pair of woven straw sandals in both hands at chest height, his weathered face behind them, softly blurred courtyard crowd behind him. Nothing written.
scenes.S29: Several villagers crouching around a heap of straw sandals on the ground, picking them up and comparing them, serious faces, others leaning in behind. Winter daylight courtyard.
scenes.S30: Exactly three elders standing in a courtyard in gray durumagi and black gat hats, their faces stiff and pale, one with his mouth slightly open, one looking away. Winter daylight.
scenes.S32: Only one person in the picture: a man in his thirties in a patched servant jacket carrying a heavy A frame load across a large tiled roof house yard, his head down, working. Daylight. Nobody else.
scenes.S33: A close view: GUMAN taking a small worn cloth money pouch out of his jacket and holding it out on his open palm, his weathered hand filling much of the frame, blurred courtyard behind. Nothing written.
scenes.S34: Only one person in the picture: GUMAN pushing his boat off a dark riverbank at night with his pole, one lantern at the bow, black water. Nobody else, no moon.
scenes.S35: Three village elders standing in a courtyard with their heads bowed and hands clasped in front of them, a heap of straw sandals on the ground before them. Winter daylight.
scenes.S36: A close view filling the whole frame: SUBOK running along a riverside path toward the water, seen full length from the side, his arms swinging, winter daylight. The river and low hills fill the rest of the frame. Nobody else.
scenes.S37: Exactly two people and nobody else at a river landing: a man in a worn servant jacket kneeling on the ground and weeping with both hands on his face, and GUMAN standing quietly beside him with one hand on his shoulder. A bundle of straw sandals on the ground. Winter daylight.
scenes.S38: [SIL] Sunset over a wide river, two men standing side by side on the bank as black silhouettes looking at the water, layered gray and silver clouds with ribbons of gold behind them.
scenes.S39: Exactly two people: a man in a hemp jacket tying new straw thatch onto the roof of a small riverside hut, and GUMAN standing below looking up at him with his pole in one hand. Daylight by the river. Nobody else.
scenes.S40: [SIL] Full moon over a wide river at night, a small ferry boat with one standing poleman as a black silhouette on the silver water, layered silver clouds and a band of gold light.
